title: Enzyme-assisted extraction and characterization of red roselle calyx (Hibiscus sabdariffa L.) bioactives and their application in ice cream matrices
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2873-2894
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00789E, Paper
Open Access

A. Priyanka, B. Nila Shireen, S. Ganga Kishore, Sudha Paramadhas, R. Rahul, Madhuresh Dwivedi, T. Pandiarajan, R. Divyabharathi, Nongmaithem Seema Chanu
Enzyme-assisted extraction (EAE) enabled sustainable colorant recovery. Cellulase maximized phenolic and flavonoid contents, pectinase anthocyanins, and amylase antioxidant activity. Ice cream quality improved. HPLC confirmed high quercetin.
